title: AutomationEnvironmentResourceOpenaiHosted

type.description: The type of the object. Always `openai_hosted`.

environment_id.description: An existing environment reference, or null when provisioning a new environment.

environment_template_id.description: A template reference, or null when no template is selected.

container_size.description: The configured container size, or null to use the creation default.

packages.description: Package overrides, or null to inherit the template or creation default.

network.description: Network overrides, or null to inherit the template or creation default.

desktop.description: Desktop overrides, or null to inherit the template or creation default.

capability_directories.description: Directory overrides, or null to inherit the template or creation default.

skills.description: Skill overrides, excluding archive contents, or null to inherit.

plugins.description: Plugin overrides, excluding archive contents, or null to inherit.

files.description: File overrides, excluding contents, or null to inherit.

description: Hosted environment selection with confidential setup commands and variables omitted.
